Annualisation factor converting weekly rates to annual rates. SoilR does the same: CenturyModel14 ships the identical vector as ks = 52 * c(...). The rates are paired with a modifier normalised to peak near 1, which is how SoilR's own CenturyModel example uses them (xi left at its default 1) - so fT.Century2's leading 3.439423 must NOT be carried into the modifier (whep#345).

UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER: this is SoilR CenturyModel's function-signature default (silt = 0.45), not a soil measurement. WHEP overrides SoilR's companion clay = 0.2 default with real per-cell HWSD clay but not this. Sweeping silt over its plausible range moves the Century equilibrium 5.565-8.765 yr, a factor 1.58 (whep#345).
UNVERIFIED: SoilR CenturyModel requires Ls with NO default, so this value is WHEP's own choice and carries no source (whep#903).

Default litter lignin-to-nitrogen ratio LN (dimensionless, order tens; feeds Fm = 0.85 - 0.018*LN). UNVERIFIED: SoilR CenturyModel requires LN with NO default, so this is WHEP's own choice. With lignin_fraction 0.5 it implies a litter C:N of 80, which is the END-of-period value in the LPJmL run (measured C:N rises 67.0 in 1901 to 71.4 by 2000), not a historical mean (whep#903).
